trans-unit.source: Employees, allowances and deductions, and exact monthly payslips.
Use your work email and password.
The email must be unique; it stays reserved after a deletion.
The tax scheme decides which payroll policy and tax method apply.
Allowances are prorated in the hire month; deductions are taken in full.

Manage employees, their pay and their payslips.
Delete ? The employee will no longer appear in lists.

employee(s) have a negative net pay this month. Review their deductions.

The English name must be unique. The Arabic name is optional; the English name is shown when it is empty.
Deductions are never taxable. The kind can change only while no employee uses the item.

This item is assigned to employees, so its kind cannot change. Payslips are not stored: they are recalculated from current data, so a new kind would change past payslips. Create a new pay item instead.
No employee uses this item yet, so its kind can still change.
The allowance and deduction types you can assign to employees.
Delete ? This is only possible while no employee (including deleted ones) uses it.
This policy covers closed months, so it is read-only. To correct the current month, create a policy effective from this month.
A policy applies from the first day of its month until the next policy of the same scheme. Past months are closed.
The rate applies to gross pay. Leave the cap empty for no cap; 0 is a real cap.
The brackets must fit the scheme's tax method.
Select a tax scheme to set its tax brackets.
The policy effective from was saved.
Social insurance and income tax rules per tax scheme, effective from a month.
This scheme has no payroll policies yet.
Delete the policy effective from ? Months it covered fall back to the previous policy.
The policy effective from was deleted.
This scheme is tax exempt: no income tax and no brackets. Social insurance still applies.
A flat tax applies one rate to all taxable income.
Each rate applies to the part of income inside its band. Upper bounds go up row by row; leave the last one empty.
Leave the upper bound of the last bracket empty.
Only the last bracket can have no upper bound.
Must be greater than the previous upper bound.
A progressive tax needs at least one bracket.
A flat tax needs exactly one bracket without an upper bound.
Your account is not linked to an employee record, so there is no payslip to show. Please contact HR.
Deductions exceed earnings this month: the net pay is negative. Review the deductions before paying.
Amounts are calculated at full precision and rounded to two decimals only for display, so lines may differ from the totals by 0.01.
can have at most two decimal places.
cannot be before the current month; past months are closed.
